name: Skeleton loader
purpose: A perceived-performance placeholder: grey bones that mirror the shape of incoming content so layout never jumps and waiting feels shorter. Distinct from Loading-indicator (use that when there is no known layout to mirror) and from the queued loader atom (spinners — GOOD-MORNING §C·3b): a skeleton never spins.

props.$note: The bone kit: 16px caption line · 24px body line · 44px avatar circle (50% idiom) · 160px media block · 44×120 control block. Compose to mirror the target component.

tokens.font-family: n/a — bones are text-free by definition; demo chrome only
tokens.bone: tertiary/background/hover (#F0F0F0/#232323) on background/default — one pair does everything
tokens.shimmer: color-mix 50% bone/page as the gradient highlight (no minted token)
tokens.shell: border/subtle + border-radius/surface for card shells; bones bind border-radius/indicator (50% avatar idiom literal)
tokens.$contrast: Deliberately low-contrast: bones are decorative (aria-hidden, no information) — 1.4.11 exempt, no pairs declared. The loading state is announced by role=status + visually-hidden text.

motion.shimmer: background-position sweep over a 3-stop gradient, 1.4s linear infinite.
motion.reducedMotion: Animation AND gradient removed — static bones (2.3.3); shape alone carries the loading read.

responsive.rule: Bones are fluid to their container and mirror the target component's own responsive footprint — the skeleton reserves exactly the space the content will take.

mustNotNeighbour: Loading-indicator for the same region (one loading signal per region)
triggeredBy: data fetch in a known layout

accessibility.role: The region carries role="status" + aria-busy="true" + a visually-hidden 'Loading content'; every bone is aria-hidden — ONE announcement per region, not per bone (4.1.3).
accessibility.name: The visually-hidden text is the accessible name of the loading state.
accessibility.keyboard: Nothing focusable — bones are inert; focus lands on real content when it arrives.
accessibility.focus: n/a (no interactive elements); the demo's resolve flips aria-busy false and removes the sr-text.
accessibility.nonText: Bones convey no information — exempt from 1.4.11; the state is carried programmatically.

antiPatterns: A spinner inside a skeleton (the loader atom is a separate queued group — never both signals at once)
Bones that do not match the incoming layout (the layout jump returns and the skeleton lied)
Announcing every bone to screen readers (one region-level status announcement only)
Uniform full-width bars for text (staggered widths read as content, uniform bars read as decoration)
Skeleton for sub-300ms loads (flash of placeholder is worse than nothing)

tokenValidation.result: PASS — bound vars match resolved light+dark; no contrast pairs by design (decorative placeholders, rationale in manifest $note).
